findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were raw ground beef patties observed to be above a package of impossible burgers in the bottom of a preparation cooler along the cook-line. CORRECTED- The raw ground beef patties were moved to be below the impossible burgers and it was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that raw proteins are arranged by cooking temperature to protect food items from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following food-contact surfaces were observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on them: 

1. The baffle of the inside of the ice machine.
2. The soda gun nozzle at the bar. 

A follow up is scheduled for 6/8/2026 to ensure that both of these food-contact surfaces have been cleaned. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The cooler drawers under the grill in the facility are observed to have an ambient temperature of 51F. The following food items were probed: 
- Three pans of steak: probed to be at 48F, 50F, and 52F. 
- A pan of chicken: 46F. 
- A pan of riblets: 50F. 
- A pan of cooked fettuccini noodles: 49F. 
CORRECTED- These items were voluntarily discarded by the PIC. A pan of cooked Penne noodles were moved into another cooler, due to only being placed in the cooler about 30 minutes prior. It is recommended to check temperatures of coolers more frequently. Ensure that TCS foods are being cold held at 41F and below.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment: The cooler drawers under the grill were observed to have an ambient temperature of 51F. TCS food items that were above 41F were voluntarily discarded by the PIC (see violation #22). A follow up is scheduled for 6/8/2026 to ensure that the cooler drawers have been repaired and are cold holding at 41F or below. Ensure that equipment used for cold and hot holding is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There are observed to be flies next to the soda syrup boxes in the back of facility that are flying around a large puddle of pooling water. A follow up is scheduled on 6/8/2026 to ensure that the flies have been eliminated and the pooling water has been cleaned up. Ensure that pest control is routinely treating the facility, the facility is being maintained cleaned, and water is not allowed to pool to prevent pest harborage conditions.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The handle is observed to be broken off of the bar cooler containing glasses. There is no handle and employees have to use a tool to pry open the door. Ensure that this handle is replaced. Equipment should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
There are a number of nonfood contact surfaces that are observed to be in need of cleaning in the facility. The following nonfood contact surfaces are in need of cleaning: 

1. SECOND REPEAT- The crevices on the front and the outside of the chip warmer. 
2. The bottom of the gasket on the left door of the first preparation cooler. 
3. The gasket and crevices of the ice cream chest freezer door. 
4. The handwashing sink in the bar area is observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on and in it. 
5. The wire shelves in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of food debris and soil residue on them. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. FIRST REPEAT- There are broken tiles next to a drain in the dish area that are allowing pooling water. Ensure that these tiles are replaced. 
2. The drain under the dish machine is observed to have broken tiles next to it that is allowing food debris and water to pool. Ensure that this is cleaned and that the tiles are replaced. 
3. The baseboard coving to the left of the walk-in freezer door inside of the walk-in cooler are observed to be coming away from the wall. Ensure that these are re-sealed to the wall. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. All repairs should be made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. THIRD REPEAT- The wall/baseboard behind the fryers. 
2. SIXTH REPEAT- The floor under equipment in the bar area. 
3. FIFTH REPEAT- The walk-in freezer floor. 
4. THIRD REPEAT- The drain to the left of the dish machine. 

Due to these first four items being repeated violations, a follow up is being scheduled for 6/29/2026 to ensure that these violations have been corrected and that cleaning is being done in the facility. 

5. FIRST REPEAT- The floor under and around the dish machine. 
6. The floor under the fryers. 
7. The vent in the hood above the dish machine. 
8. The walls and ceilings in both walk-in coolers are observed to have an accumulation of soil residue and mold on them. 
9. There is pooling water in the corner by the soda syrup boxes that is allowing pooling water. Ensure that water is not allowed to pool to prevent pest harborage conditions. 

Ensure that physical facilities are being cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
